# Overlap correction by deconvolution {#sec-deconvolution}

Deconvolution, and the complete analysis this chapter worked through on
Ehinger and Dimigen's face recording (Figure 11 of the Unfold toolbox
paper), are in the manual of the Deconvolve plugin:
<https://markspan.github.io/AlakazamDeconvolve/#sec-deconvolution>.
Deconvolve is a plugin, from the repository AlakazamDeconvolve: install it
with **Install plugins** (@sec-plugins). Its two templates, the
face-saccade analysis and fixation-related potentials in reading, come
with it.
